The conformance run itself returned 1 because the SoftPosit adapter reported
7,562 differences. The exact FloatLean specification and an independent source
audit later showed that all of those differences are SoftPosit pX2 defects; the
raw failing logs remain in this bundle.

The campaign packager also returned 1 because `cp -a` tried to preserve pod
ownership on EFS. The files had already been copied and the campaign manifest
verified. We recovered the same staging tree with rsync while deliberately not
preserving owner, group, or mode. No test was rerun and no raw result was
rewritten during recovery.

Original campaign status:
run_exit_code=1
packaging_exit_code=1
final_exit_code=1
